### `browser-cli chrome-start`

```
Usage: browser-cli chrome-start [OPTIONS]

  Start Chrome with --remote-debugging-port for CDP access.

  This is required on Windows/Linux before using session extraction commands.
  On macOS this is optional (AppleScript is used by default).

Options:
  -p, --port INTEGER  Remote debugging port.  [default: 9222]
  --chrome-path TEXT  Explicit path to the Chrome executable. Auto-detected if
                      omitted.
  --profile TEXT      Chrome profile directory name (e.g. 'Default', 'Profile
                      1').
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```

### `browser-cli session`

```
Usage: browser-cli session [OPTIONS] DOMAIN

  Extract session info (localStorage / cookies) from a Chrome tab.

  DOMAIN is the domain substring to match against open Chrome tab URLs.

  Examples:
    browser-cli session example.com -ls authToken
    browser-cli session myapp.io -ck session_id -cp wordpress_logged_in
    browser-cli session example.com -ls token --backend cdp --port 9222

Options:
  -ls, --local-storage TEXT       localStorage key(s) to retrieve. Repeatable.
  -ck, --cookie TEXT              Cookie name(s) to retrieve (exact match).
                                  Repeatable.
  -cp, --cookie-prefix TEXT       Cookie name prefix(es) to retrieve.
                                  Repeatable.
  --backend [auto|applescript|cdp]
                                  Session extraction backend.  [default: auto]
  -p, --port INTEGER              CDP port (only used with --backend=cdp).
                                  [default: 9222]
  --json                          Output as JSON.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

```

## Commands

---

### `git-cli commit-info`

```
Usage: git-cli commit-info [OPTIONS] [EXTRA]...

  Gather staged diff, recent logs, and commit style guide for AI-assisted
  commit message generation.

  Any trailing arguments are passed through as extra instructions.

Options:
  -m, --module TEXT  Module name to prefix the commit subject with [module].
  -v, --verbose      Request a detailed body in addition to the subject line.
  --help             Show this message and exit.
```

### `git-cli log`

```
Usage: git-cli log [OPTIONS] [COMMIT_INPUT]

  Fetch commit logs with diffs.

  COMMIT_INPUT formats: <SHA>, <SHA1>..<SHA2>, <SHA>~<N>

  Use --branch to automatically detect the commit range for the current
  feature branch (must start with 'f/').

Options:
  -b, --branch  Auto-detect feature branch range (f/... → base..HEAD).
  --help        Show this message and exit.
```

### `taiga-cli create-userstory`

```

  Create a User Story with tasks and custom attributes in one go

                            "description": "..."}]'
